title: The Smile of Old Chapel Road Again
author: Wren Amberdale
blurb: Isandro Dravenmoor, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
